query: How will you name and formalize local partnerships, language leads, and capacity-building milestones, and what budgets and timelines will support them?

response.query: How will you name and formalize local partnerships, language leads, and capacity-building milestones, and what budgets and timelines will support them?
response.answer: Local partnerships will be named "Community Alliances," language leads as "Language Coordinators," and milestones as "Capacity Milestones." Budgets and timelines will be determined by project-specific funding and timelines.
